_readme: Declarative story for the synthetic fixture home. scripts/fixture_home.py reads this
and materialises three trees plus a baseline manifest into a temporary directory.
Modes and symlinks live here rather than in git because git records neither.
'expect' is the hand-written list of statuses the detector must produce for that path.
An empty list is a NEGATIVE CONTROL: a detector that flags everything fails on it.

.aliases.story: was a symlink, an installer replaced it with a copy. Content still matches, so a content-only detector sees nothing.

.badfence.story: unterminated local fence. Stripping must fail closed, not swallow the rest of the file.

.bashrc.story: identical in all three. NEGATIVE CONTROL.

.config/apprc.story: locally edited, quotable, and the machine copy grew a credential-shaped line. POSITIVE CONTROL for the redactor.

.config/blockrc.story: quotable file that differs both inside and outside the local fence. The quoted diff must show the outside change and must never print anything from inside the block.

.config/escape.conf.story: symlink retargeted outside the home and repo roots. Must be reported and never read.

.config/newtool.conf.story: new file in a tracked directory. Detected by listing the directory, never opened.

.config/removed-upstream.conf.story: dropped from the repo, still on the machine.

.converged.conf.story: both sides changed since the sync and landed on the same content.

.editorconfig.story: identical apart from CRLF line endings. NEGATIVE CONTROL under the default, a finding under --no-normalize.

.gitconfig.story: edited on the machine, repo untouched since the last sync.

.gone-everywhere.story: baseline remembers a file neither side has.

.inputrc.story: tracked file deleted from the machine.

.newfile-from-repo.story: in the repo, never installed here, no baseline.

.no-baseline.conf.story: differs with no baseline entry. Direction is unknowable and the tool says so.

.npmrc.story: locally edited AND listed as quotable in the fixture config. The denylist must still refuse to print it.

.profile.story: differs only inside the machine-local fence. NEGATIVE CONTROL.

.ssh/config.story: content identical everywhere, mode loosened from 0600 to 0644. ssh will refuse keys over this.

.ssh/id_ed25519.story: private key on the machine, deliberately not in the repo, mode loosened. Denylisted for quoting.

.tmux.conf.story: both sides changed and disagree. The dangerous case.

.vimrc.story: changed in the repo, machine still holds the synced version.

.zshrc.story: symlink into the repo, still correct. NEGATIVE CONTROL.
